shared_elements: rows or bands of repeated short linear signs
justification: The strongest shared content is the presence of schematic profile creatures, including bird-like forms, together with repeated linear sign rows and occasional circular/oval motifs. The biggest difference is that B is dominated by boats, quadrupeds, stick-like humans and dispersed small signs, while A is organized in stacked carved panels with large bird/animal figures and dense geometric bands, so the relationships and overall iconographic scheme do not closely match.
